preds.description: NumPy array encoding a batch of predictions.

top.description: Integer, how many top-guesses to return. Defaults to `5`.

output.description: A list of lists of top class prediction tuples `(class_name, class_description, score)`. One list of tuples per sample in batch input.

constraints: ValueError: In case of invalid shape of the `pred` array (must be 2D).
